scope: Read-only review of the quoted allowed-value parser change and its focused unittest. The concurrent atom_search provenance diff is outside this parser gate.

checks.name: quoted_ampersand_value
checks.evidence: A quoted allowed value such as Analysis & Advisory parses as one ValueLiteral and renders canonically with quotes; an unquoted ampersand remains rejected.

checks.name: malformed_quoted_values
checks.evidence: Unterminated, empty, whitespace-only, backslash-containing, control-character-containing, and quote-adjacent junk forms reject with SubjectNotationError.

checks.name: rendering_and_round_trip
checks.evidence: Reserved printable literal values render quoted, avoiding reinterpretation as Subject grammar; ordinary existing unquoted values retain the existing name path.

checks.name: changed_file_lint_delta
checks.evidence: Ruff reports only C901 on _parse_selector_literal and path. The same two diagnostics occur on the HEAD version; neither is introduced by this patch.

not_checked: Current source publication, projections, runtime, full evaluator, or deployment behavior
